This document integrates the two numbered scripts in the former **RepeatMR** folder. It summarizes PheWAS/PhenoScanner evidence for the genetic instruments and then repeats the MR analysis after removing the recorded instruments. Replace `"Path"` once in the setup chunk; outputs are written to `RepeatMR/outputs`.

## Integrated setup and relative paths

```{r repeat-mr-00-setup, include=FALSE}
# Source file: integrated setup from both RepeatMR files
# Integrated setup shared by every chunk.
project_root <- normalizePath("Path", winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)

data_dir               <- file.path(project_root, "Data")
metabolite_gwas_dir    <- file.path(data_dir, "Metabolite_GWAS")
sleep_gwas_dir         <- file.path(data_dir, "Sleep_GWAS")
reference_dir          <- file.path(data_dir, "Reference")
ld_bfile               <- file.path(data_dir, "LD_Reference", "EUR")
phenoscanner_dir       <- file.path(data_dir, "PhenoScanner")

code_dir               <- file.path(project_root, "MetaboliteSleep_Code")
mr_code_dir            <- file.path(code_dir, "MR")
repeat_code_dir        <- file.path(code_dir, "RepeatMR")
coloc_code_dir         <- file.path(code_dir, "Colocalization")
mr_output_dir          <- file.path(mr_code_dir, "outputs")
repeat_output_dir      <- file.path(repeat_code_dir, "outputs")
coloc_output_dir       <- file.path(coloc_code_dir, "outputs")

dir.create(mr_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
for (d in c("clump_data", "harmonise_data", "mr_res", "Fisher's test")) {
  dir.create(file.path(mr_output_dir, d), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
dir.create(repeat_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

catalog_file            <- file.path(reference_dir, "gwas_catalog_summary_statistics_table_export.tsv")
sleep_trait_file        <- file.path(reference_dir, "GWAS_sleep_trait.xlsx")

# Resolve paths stored in the sleep metadata workbook. Existing absolute paths
# are used when present; otherwise the file is located by basename under Data/Sleep_GWAS.
resolve_sleep_resource <- function(path_value) {
  path_value <- as.character(path_value)
  if (file.exists(path_value)) return(normalizePath(path_value, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
  hits <- list.files(sleep_gwas_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  hits <- hits[basename(hits) == basename(path_value)]
  if (length(hits) == 1L) return(normalizePath(hits, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
  if (length(hits) == 0L) stop("Sleep-GWAS resource not found under Data/Sleep_GWAS: ", basename(path_value))
  stop("More than one matching sleep-GWAS resource was found: ", paste(basename(hits), collapse = ", "))
}

pathway_file            <- file.path(reference_dir, "20231120_metabolite_pathway.xlsx")
hmdb_file               <- file.path(reference_dir, "20231121_1091metabolite_HMDBID.xlsx")
ultimate_trait_file     <- file.path(reference_dir, "20240322_metabolite_id_ulttrait.xlsx")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(data.table)
  library(readxl)
  library(openxlsx)
  library(TwoSampleMR)
  library(plinkbinr)
  library(ieugwasr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(mr.raps)
})
```

## 1. Phenotype summary for significant results and instrumental variables

This chunk combines the five PhenoScanner exports and retains associations with P < 5e-8.

```{r repeat-mr-01-01-phenotype-summary}
# Source file: 1_Phenotype_summary_sigres_IVs.Rmd
dat<-fread(file.path(phenoscanner_dir, "trait_variants_annotated_1.txt"))
dat1<-fread(file.path(phenoscanner_dir, "trait_variants_annotated_2.txt"))
dat2<-fread(file.path(phenoscanner_dir, "trait_variants_annotated_3.txt"))
dat3<-fread(file.path(phenoscanner_dir, "trait_variants_annotated_4.txt"))
dat4<-fread(file.path(phenoscanner_dir, "trait_variants_annotated_5.txt"))
dat<-rbind(dat,dat1,dat2,dat3,dat4)

dat$`P-value`<-as.double(dat$`P-value`)
dat<-subset(dat,`P-value`<5e-8)

write.xlsx(dat,file.path(repeat_output_dir, "Phenotype_summary_sigres_IVs.xlsx"))

trait<-unique(dat$`GWAS Trait`)
write.csv(trait,file.path(repeat_output_dir, "Phenotype_summary_sigres_IVs_uniqueTraits.csv"),row.names = F)
```

## 2. Repeated MR after removing selected instrumental variables

This chunk reuses harmonized MR data, removes the IVs listed in the repeat-analysis exclusion table, and repeats IVW, MR-Egger, weighted-median, and MR-RAPS estimates.

```{r repeat-mr-02-01-repeat-mr}
# Source file: 2_metabolites_and_sleep_mr_repeat.Rmd
combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

all_res<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)

sig_id<-read_excel(file.path(mr_output_dir, "metabolite_sleep_primary_fdrmethod0.05.xlsx"), sheet = "Sheet 1")
sig_out<-sig_id$outcome
sig_id<-sig_id$exposure

sleep_table<-read_excel(sleep_trait_file, sheet = "sleep_trait_out")

rm_ivs<-read_excel(file.path(reference_dir, "repeatMR_removedIVs.xlsx"), sheet = "Sheet1")
rm_ivs<-unique(rm_ivs$SNP)

k<-1
for (id in sig_id) {
  
  for (j in 1:10) {
    if(sleep_table[j,'trait']==sig_out[k]){
        i<-j
    }
  }
  
    if(file.exists(paste(file.path(mr_output_dir, "harmonise_data"), "/", id, "_", sleep_table[i, "trait"], "_har.RData", sep = ""))){
      folder_path<-paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",sep = "")
      dir.create(folder_path)
    
      load(paste(file.path(mr_output_dir, "harmonise_data"), "/", id, "_", sleep_table[i, "trait"], "_har.RData", sep = ""))
      
      exp_out_har3<-exp_out_har3[!exp_out_har3$SNP %in% rm_ivs,]
    }
    else next
    
    ##har3_mr
    #MR with default method=deft
    if(nrow(subset(exp_out_har3,mr_keep==TRUE))>1){
    exp_out_har3_mrdeft<-mr(exp_out_har3,method_list=                               
                              c("mr_ivw","mr_egger_regression","mr_weighted_median"))
    exp_out_har3_mrhet<-mr_heterogeneity(exp_out_har3)
    exp_out_har3_mrplt<-mr_pleiotropy_test(exp_out_har3)
    exp_out_har3_mrsin<-mr_singlesnp(exp_out_har3)
    exp_out_har3_mrloo<-mr_leaveoneout(exp_out_har3)

    #plots
    exp_out_har3_scatP<-mr_scatter_plot(exp_out_har3_mrdeft,exp_out_har3)
    exp_out_har3_scatP
    ggsave(exp_out_har3_scatP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har3_scatP.pdf",sep = "")))

    exp_out_har3_sinP<-mr_forest_plot(exp_out_har3_mrsin)
    exp_out_har3_sinP
    ggsave(exp_out_har3_sinP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har3_sinP.pdf",sep = "")))

    exp_out_har3_looP<-mr_leaveoneout_plot(exp_out_har3_mrloo)
    exp_out_har3_looP
    ggsave(exp_out_har3_looP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har3_looP.pdf",sep = "")))

    exp_out_har3_funnelP<-mr_funnel_plot(exp_out_har3_mrsin)
    exp_out_har3_funnelP
    ggsave(exp_out_har3_funnelP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har3_funnelP.pdf",sep = "")))

    #combine_all_mrresults 
    exp_out_har3_mrallres<-combine_all_mrresults(res = exp_out_har3_mrdeft, 
                                           het= exp_out_har3_mrhet,
                                           plt =exp_out_har3_mrplt,
                                           sin = exp_out_har3_mrsin, 
                                           ao_slc = FALSE)
    write.csv(exp_out_har3_mrallres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har3_mr_allres.csv",sep = "")))

    ##subset for rbind
    exp_out_har3_mrsubres<-exp_out_har3_mrallres[-which(exp_out_har3_mrallres$Method==
                                                          "Wald ratio"),]
    exp_out_har3_mrsubres<-exp_out_har3_mrsubres[,c("Method","outcome","exposure",                              "nsnp","b","se","pval","Q","Q_df","Q_pval","intercept",                                   "intercept_se","intercept_pval","id.outcome","id.exposure")]
    write.csv(exp_out_har3_mrsubres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har3_mr_subres.csv",sep = "")))

    #add mr.raps for weak instrumental
    exp_out_har3_mrraps<-mr.raps(b_exp = exp_out_har3$beta.exposure,
                                 b_out = exp_out_har3$beta.outcome,
                                 se_exp = exp_out_har3$se.exposure,
                                 se_out = exp_out_har3$se.outcome)
    write.csv(exp_out_har3_mrraps,file= 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har3_mr_rapsres.csv",sep = "")))

    ##transform list to data.frame
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re<-as.data.frame(exp_out_har3_mrraps)

    ##rename colnames to merge
    setnames(exp_out_har3_mrraps_re,c("beta.hat","beta.se","beta.p.value"),
             c("b","se","pval"))
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$Method<-"MR RAPS"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$outcome<-as.character(sleep_table[i,'trait'])
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$exposure<-as.character(id)
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$nsnp<-exp_out_har3_mrdeft[1,"nsnp"]
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$Q<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$Q_df<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$Q_pval<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$intercept<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$intercept_se<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$intercept_pval<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$id.outcome<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$id.exposure<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re<-exp_out_har3_mrraps_re[,c("Method","outcome","exposure",                       "nsnp","b","se","pval","Q","Q_df","Q_pval","intercept","intercept_se",                                             "intercept_pval","id.outcome","id.exposure")]

    #rbind mr results
    exp_out_har3_mr_bindres<-rbind(exp_out_har3_mrsubres,exp_out_har3_mrraps_re)
    exp_out_har3_mr_bindres$exp_out_har_pair=as.character(paste(id,                                                           sleep_table[i,'trait'],"har3",sep = "_"))
    write.csv(exp_out_har3_mr_bindres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har3_mr_bindres.csv",sep = "")))
    }else if(nrow(subset(exp_out_har3,mr_keep==TRUE))==1){
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,                 b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,                   intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)
      exp_out_har3_mrdeft<-mr(exp_out_har3)
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres[1,"Method"]<-exp_out_har3_mrdeft[1,"method"]
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres[1,"outcome"]<-exp_out_har3_mrdeft[1,"outcome"]
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres[1,"exposure"]<-exp_out_har3_mrdeft[1,"exposure"]
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres[1,"nsnp"]<-exp_out_har3_mrdeft[1,"nsnp"]
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres[1,"b"]<-exp_out_har3_mrdeft[1,"b"]
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres[1,"se"]<-exp_out_har3_mrdeft[1,"se"]
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres[1,"pval"]<-exp_out_har3_mrdeft[1,"pval"]
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres[1,"id.outcome"]<-exp_out_har3_mrdeft[1,"id.outcome"]
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres[1,"id.exposure"]<-exp_out_har3_mrdeft[1,"id.exposure"]
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres[1,"exp_out_har_pair"]=as.character(
        paste(id,sleep_table[i,'trait'],"har3",sep = "_"))
      write.csv(exp_out_har3_mr_bindres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har3_mr_bindres.csv",sep = "")))
    }else{
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,                 b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,                   intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres[1,"Method"]<-"None"
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres[1,"outcome"]<-as.character(sleep_table[i,'trait'])
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres[1,"exposure"]<-as.character(id)
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres[1,"nsnp"]<-nrow(exp_out_har3)
    }
    
    
    ##bind all for each pair
    all_mr_bindres<-exp_out_har3_mr_bindres
    write.csv(all_mr_bindres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har_mr_bindres.csv",sep = "")))
    save.image(file = file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har_mr_bindres.RData",sep = "")))
    
    ##bind all
    all_res<-rbind(all_res,all_mr_bindres)
    
    k<-k+1

}

#save all_res
all_res<-all_res[-1,]
write.csv(all_res,file = file.path(paste("mr_res/metabolite_sleep_mr_repeat_bindres.csv",
                                         sep = "")))
write.xlsx(all_res,file = file.path(paste("mr_res/metabolite_sleep_mr_repeat_bindres.xlsx",
                                         sep = "")))
```
